reviews.title: Hands down best chair for your money
reviews.comment: Absolutely the best chair I've ever sat in! The quality is obvious from the moment I opened the box. It was packaged well and arrived quickly and in good condition. Set up was a breeze and when I sat on it I felt the comfort I have been looking for! I have had several days to try it out and I have to say sitting at my desk for 8+ hours a day has never been easier. The adjustments make the chair even better! I highly recommend this chair to anyone who experiences back/hip pain, especially if you sit for long periods of time!
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.title: Great to work with. Great product.
reviews.comment:
Product arrived damaged. Exterior of box showed damage and puncture to the middle section. Upon opening the box, I found that that was the area of the box that the seat was placed. The plastic on the bottom of the seat was cracked. I've started a refund and hope to get this resolved quickly.
Edit:
The replacement process was very smooth and a lot faster than I expected. The seller promptly answered questions and concerns and provided a replacement very quickly. They were very easy to work with.
Now that I have the chair, it seems to be exactly what I was needing. It has the option of slightly higher arm rest height than what I saw when looking at other options which helps a lot with my desk in my home office. It supports my back comfortably for long hours at the computer while working and while gaming.
With how easy they were to work with and with the chair being what I’d hoped for I’m changing the review to a 5/5.
reviews.author: Charity

reviews.title: Arm rest adjustments need improvement
reviews.comment: I thought the arm rest could be adjusted lower.  Only 3 adjust points.  Lateral arm rest adjustment do not stay in place. Seat is wider than what I imagine. Wish they would label all the adjustment levers. If I could give 3.5 stars.  Price seems on par with similar ergo chairs. There video assembly online. Big plus the chair was delivered a week before Xmas
reviews.author: gokcchiefs

reviews.title: Good quality, but uncomfortable for me
reviews.comment: The quality is good, but the chair has caused pretty bad back fatigue for me after sitting in it for just 15 minutes or so. I'm not sure if it just doesn't fit my body? I can't for the life of me adjust it to be comfortable for me. Maybe the one with the foam cushion would be better and more supportive. Might work for you, but I'm sending it back.
reviews.author: TWood

reviews.title: The chair is comfortable and can be adjusted to fit your needs
reviews.comment: It is a bit awkward at first. Finding comfortable positions is a little tricky but due to the large amount of knobs and levers you can eventually find positions that are comfortable for you. The chair reclines and also has a comfortable upright position. Overall its not bad. I kinda wish the arm rests were a bit longer and a bit wider.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
